title: Swift Rapid NGS Part 3 - Extension, SPRI, and Ligation
author: Opentrons
materials: 23ul of mastermix is added to each sample
Samples are then moved to the magnetic module.
Magnetic beads are added to samples.
Samples are incubated at room temperature.
Plate is placed back on magnetic module.
Low EDTA TE is added to beads, incubate.

steps.title: Prepare Extension Mastermix at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Make the Extension Mastermix on the Opentrons Aluminum 24‑tube rack set at 4 °C, mix and pulse the mastermix, then return the tube to the rack.

steps.title: Add Extension Mastermix to Samples
steps.instruction: Dispense 23 µL of the prepared Extension Mastermix into each sample well.

steps.title: Run Thermocycler Profile
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the prescribed Extension profile.

steps.title: Transfer Samples to Magnetic Module
steps.instruction: Move the plate from the thermocycler to the magnetic module.

steps.title: Add Low‑EDTA TE to Samples
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL of Low‑EDTA TE to each sample.

steps.title: Add Magnetic Beads
steps.instruction: Add the required volume of magnetic beads to each sample.

steps.title: Incubate Samples at Room Temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature (RT) for the time indicated in the protocol.

steps.title: Pause: Remove, Seal, and Spin Plate
steps.instruction: Pause the run: remove the plate from the deck, seal it, and spin down the contents.

steps.title: Place Plate Back on Magnetic Module
steps.instruction: Return the sealed plate to the magnetic module.

steps.title: Remove Supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard the supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Perform Two Ethanol Washes
steps.instruction: Conduct two ethanol washes: add ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds, then remove the supernatant. Repeat the three actions a second time.

steps.title: Pause: Remove, Seal, and Spin Plate
steps.instruction: Pause the run: remove the plate from the deck, seal it, and spin down the contents.

steps.title: Add Low‑EDTA TE and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add Low‑EDTA TE to the bead pellet and incubate for the time specified in the protocol.

steps.title: Pause: Remove, Seal, and Spin Plate
steps.instruction: Pause the run: remove the plate from the deck, seal it, and spin down the contents.

steps.title: Transfer Supernatant to Columns 5‑7
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared supernatant into columns 5, 6, and 7 of the downstream plate.
